ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central expanse; continuous black peripheral band along the superior and lateral edges; a dense patch of irregular black mottling in the upper-left visible quadrant; four vertical tan-colored linear bands in the central-medial area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits non-uniform, irregular serrations with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 10 to 25 pixels; the frequency of irregularities is higher towards the distal fluke tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The visible right lateral margin exhibits a continuous convex sweep terminating in a sharp distal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle attachment points) ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in diameter, localized along the dark peripheral margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear disruptions present on the white ventral field, including two prominent parallel vertical streaks in the superior-central region and several smaller, unaligned scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the trailing edge and outer lobe tip; distinct yellow-brown organic staining localized in the central-left white field.
